profile.headline: Software Engineer @Liaison | MS CS @SFSU
profile.summary: Passionate in bridging tech and design to enhance user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Node.js · PostgreSQL · TypeScript · React · Python · Ruby on Rails · Apex

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Developed 3D and virtual reality applications to provide a safe and immersive training experience for the Structural Engineers Association of Northern California’s Safety Assessment Program
• Technologies/Tools Used: Unity, C#

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching Assistant for Data Visualization: Concepts, Tools, Techniques, and Paradigms (CSC 805)

positions.title: UX Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Enhanced usability for Speech-to-Text transcription service by providing user-configurable language support, custom terms, number of speakers, and speech models, improving overall transcription accuracy for long-form interviews in research studies
• Participated in holistic process from designing and building lo-fi and hi-fi prototypes to releasing new features in production
• Collaborated with designers and UX researchers to conduct usability studies and gather informative insights for design reiteration
• Established API contract with software engineers to simplify and fulfill backend technical requirements
• Technologies/Tools Used: React.js, TypeScript, Figma (for designing prototypes)
positions.insights: Skills: React · TypeScript · Figma (Software) · User Experience (UX)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of interactive kanban board reflecting recruiting pipeline to streamline staffing process for recruiters and significantly reduce time to hire for clients
• Built agency experience and APIs to showcase agency profile and highlight relevant projects resulting in increase of agency hiring
• Implemented job template system which sped up the job posting process to attract highly-skilled freelancers
• Rebuilt and owned permission service for enterprise and agency users to unify access management logic and improve performance
• Technologies Used: Vue.js, Nuxt.js, Symfony (PHP), Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, AWS, Jenkins, Grafana
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Vue · Angular · Nuxt.js · Spring Boot · Symfony Framework · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built notification system to enhance workflow productivity between freelancers and clients
• Developed an agency outreach system for client support team to bring in new agencies to the platform
• Implemented personalized client homepage to surface top candidates matching clients’ hiring preferences
• Technologies Used: Angular.js, Symfony (PHP), Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Angular · Spring Boot · Symfony Framework · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Built internal admin dashboard for support team to manage client information
• Technologies Used: Rails, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, PostgreSQL

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Teaching Assistant for Programming Methodology (CSC 340, in C++) and Software Development (CSC 413, in Java)

• Led TA sessions to help students with data structures and algorithms in Java and C++
• Facilitated class discussions and coding activities
• Wrote test cases to build projects using Travis CI

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Developed data visualization dashboard for museum collections
• Technologies Used: D3.js, JavaScript, PHP, HTML, CSS

company.name: SFMOMA San Francisco Museum of Modern Art

positions.title: Apprenticeship Assistant
positions.description: • Organized and refined student apprenticeship information systems to provide accurate and structured data analysis

honors.title: College of Science and Engineering Student Project Showcase - 3rd Place
honors.description:
As part of the annual College of Science and Engineering (CoSE) Student Project Showcase, our team of 4 graduate students presented our research project which utilizes technology to increase safety and improve resilient design in the structural engineering field, as well as to educate the broader community about STEM.

More information can be found in the links below:
https://cose.sfsu.edu/2023-student-project-showcase-winners
https://cose.sfsu.edu/2023-149-csm
honors.issuer: Issued by San Francisco State University · May 2023

projects.title: CarToGo
projects.description:
• Led a team of four to design and build a car rental web application focusing on user-centered design principles
• Conducted user research to collect usability feedbacks and incorporated in iterations
• Technologies/Tools Used: Vue.js, Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, Figma (for designing low fidelity and high fidelity mockups)

Source code: https://github.com/khanhngg/csc642-842-fall21-team05

projects.title: Soulnare
projects.description:
• Built a dating mobile application that connects users via their music preferences
• Technologies Used: Kotlin (Android), Jetpack Compose, Spotify API, Firestore Database
